assertions.name: reproduces_published_light_kappas
assertions.source: End-to-end check: this independent extraction from the qou-mass isotope witnesses reproduces the published kappa values for the four original mirror pairs. Tolerance is 2e-3, not machine-level: the qou-mass isotope table and the original scoping probe draw on AME tabulations that differ at the 4th decimal (max observed deviation ~4e-4). That floor is recorded rather than tuned away, and is far below the ~7% scatter the hypotheses are judged on.

assertions.name: series_extended_beyond_A13
assertions.source: The series now reaches the A ~ 41 discrimination regime.

description: The discriminating test for the open two-like-charge EM-linking invariant (bean qou-i6rg): extends the kappa(A) mirror series from A <= 13 to the full A = 2Z-1 ladder using the corpus's own AME reference binding energies, and scores the three tied hypotheses (coth-saturation, Freedman-He with Vol ~ A, Freedman-He with Vol ~ Z) over the extended range where they diverge. Nothing fitted: the per-pair Coulomb unit and all exponents are fixed in advance. Includes an end-to-end validation that the recomputed light-pair kappa values reproduce the published ones.

WARRANT_WITHDRAWN_H_FH.why: The Vol^(-1/3) these are named for is Khesin Thm 3.6, the SINGLE-knotted-torus bound. The Freedman-He LINK bound that applies to a multi-component Borromean configuration (Komendarczyk arXiv:0808.1533v1 eq. 43) carries (pi/16)^(1/4), a pure constant, and NO volume factor. Calling these 'the Freedman-He template' was a misattribution.
WARRANT_WITHDRAWN_H_FH.consequence: H_FH_A and H_FH_Z are BARE POWER LAWS with no literature backing -- the bar the anti-fit discipline sets, which they no longer clear. The scores below are unchanged and remain a valid DESCRIPTION of the data; what changes is that a good H_FH score no longer counts as structural support. This does not make H_coth correct -- it removes its rival's warrant.

unbound_exclusion.why: 5He/5Li and 9B are particle-unbound; their tabulated binding energies are resonance parameters, not bound-state observables. Declared in advance, not selected from residuals; both fits reported.

data.verdict: kappa stays above 1 across the series (min 1.53109), so H_coth is not falsified outright; the ranking is ['H_FH_Z: kappa * Z^(1/3) const', 'H_coth: arccoth(kappa) / A^(1/3) const', 'H_FH_A: kappa * A^(1/3) const']. Note the per-pair Coulomb unit is held at its A=3 value throughout, as in the original scoping probe; any A-dependence of the underlying strong bond B_pp is therefore absorbed into kappa and remains a confound.
